content.short: HackQuest provides self-guided Web3 developer education platform.
content.description: HackQuest provides expert-curated, zero-to-hero Web3 smart-contract development learning tracks and certifications co-issued by ecosystems including Arbitrum, Solana, and Mantle Network. All HackQuest courses are built following the Universal Design of Learning (UDL), ensuring accessibility and inclusivity for all learners, regardless of abilities or learning styles. The program supports learners as they advance through the material and engage with the broader ecosystem of Web3 smart contracts.
